wish_topics.evidence_span: accelerating the adoption of sustainable technology and practices
Transitioning to renewable energy sources, minimizing waste, and conserving resources is crucial for our future
The impact of climate change is disproportionately felt by marginalized communities. Reducing pollution and promoting sustainable solutions can help create a more just and equitable society
I would promote open access to information and education about sustainable living, climate change facts, and solutions
I would encourage increased investment in research, development, and deployment of sustainable technologies
I would facilitate global collaboration to incentivize and share best practices on sustainable practices
